examples.en: Lin Hao even took online classes with me so I could pass the bar exam. If he finds out I lost my job, I'll feel so guilty toward him.
examples.zh: 林浩为了我能考上律师证，还陪我上网课。他要知道我丢了工作，我觉得特别对不起他。

examples.en: The person you should feel guilty toward is yourself. What does your future have to do with Lin Hao?
examples.zh: 你对不起的人，是你自己。你的将来跟林浩有什么关系？
